peerMapping.justification: The block is built around SP500 at 50.729 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity. XYZ100 carries the largest peer weight because it is the nearest index substitute, while the single-name peers are the mega-cap constituents that explain much of SP500 earnings, duration, and risk-on beta. Weights are positive, sum to exactly 1, and are tilted by economic comparability first, then restrained where displayed 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions is far below the target. GOLD is used only as the primary risk hedge, not as a peer, because its risk-off and real-rate channel diversifies the equity return stream.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVDA is a dominant SP500 return driver through AI semiconductors, data-center capex, and index concentration. It transmits the same earnings-revision and real-rate channel as SP500, but the weight is capped because displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 4.508 USD millions, far below the equity index.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: MSFT is a core mega-cap constituent linking SP500 to cloud software, enterprise spending, AI infrastructure, and buyback-supported earnings. Its long-duration cash flows make it sensitive to the same discount-rate moves as the index; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.581 USD millions, so the weight stays below the hedge.

peers.name: Apple
peers.reason: AAPL connects SP500 to global consumer hardware demand, services margins, supply-chain costs, and large buybacks. It is highly comparable as a mega-cap index weight, but displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.905 USD millions, which is modest next to SP500.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: GOOGL reflects the digital advertising cycle, cloud growth, AI investment, and regulatory risk inside SP500 communication services. It shares the index's growth and discount-rate channel, with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 4.758 USD millions.

peers.name: Amazon
peers.reason: AMZN gives SP500 exposure to consumer discretionary spending, cloud computing through AWS, advertising, and logistics input costs. It is a risk-on earnings proxy with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 1.649 USD millions, so its weight is meaningful but limited.

peers.name: Meta Platforms
peers.reason: META is another advertising and AI-capex proxy that co-moves with SP500 when risk appetite and nominal growth expectations rise. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.61 USD millions, and idiosyncratic regulatory and metaverse spending risk keep the weight moderate.

peers.name: Nasdaq-100
peers.reason: Nasdaq-100 is the closest return substitute because it overlaps heavily with the mega-cap growth stocks that drive SP500 and shares the same long-duration discount-rate and risk-on channel. Its 52.585 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity is the closest match to SP500 at 50.729 USD millions.

peers.name: Tesla
peers.reason: TSLA adds high-beta consumer discretionary, electric-vehicle margin, and rate-sensitive risk-on exposure that can amplify SP500 drawdowns and rebounds. Displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 4.787 USD millions, but company-specific volatility is high, so the weight is small.

peers.name: WTI crude oil
peers.reason: CL is the cross-asset input-cost and inflation peer: stronger oil can signal firm global demand but also pressure margins, consumer real income, and rate expectations for SP500. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 40.091 USD millions, yet its return comparability to a broad equity index is lower, so it receives only a small weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: Gold
primary_index_hedge.reason: Gold is the cleanest non-equity hedge in CORE_UNIVERSE for SP500 because it can absorb risk-off flows when real yields fall, the dollar softens, or equity volatility rises. Its 23.982 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity is deep enough to size a hedge without switching into another equity index.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
